reorder_compute_for_overlap: reorder compute and communication nodes in PyTorch Inductor to maximize overlap between collective operations and compute
reorder_compute_and_comm_for_overlap: apply a sequence of reordering passes to schedule compute and communication nodes for maximum overlap
sink_waits: sink wait nodes as late as possible in the schedule to optimize communication overlap
raise_comms: raise collective communication nodes as early as possible in the schedule to optimize communication overlap
visualize_overlap: visualize the estimated runtime and overlap between communication and compute operations in an Inductor schedule
